name: Dual Contouring of Hermite Data
definition: A contouring strategy that optimizes vertex placements within each grid cell using a quadratic error function (QEF) to reconstruct surfaces from Hermite data (point-normal pairs).
summary: Dual Contouring of Hermite Data is a surface extraction algorithm that reconstructs polygonal meshes by optimizing vertex placement within grid cells using a Quadratic Error Function, distinguishing itself from averaging-based methods by preserving sharp features through precise vertex positioning.
